name: Darrow Hill
summary: In northern Hillsbrad, Darrow Hill's rugged grassland rises beneath the Headland. Mountain lions and stags roam its open slopes, while feral yetis lurk in the Foothill Caverns. Alterac Granite draws travelers into this dangerous frontier.

sections.title: A Treacherous Frontier
sections.body: Darrow Hill stretches below the Headland, joining southern Hillsbrad's rolling pasture to Alterac's jagged, colder heights. Mountain lions and stags move through tall grasses on its rocky slopes, and towering yetis emerge from the Foothill Caverns. The cavern walls hold deposits of dense Alterac Granite, drawing quarry workers, miners, and adventurers into danger. Regional claims remain contentious, and travelers of either faction can be caught unaware on the trails.

faq.answer: Darrow Hill lies in northern Hillsbrad Foothills, directly south of the rocky bluffs called the Headland and east of the main mountain road into Alterac.

faq.q: What creatures threaten travelers around Darrow Hill?
faq.answer: Stags and mountain lions prowl the open slopes, while savage yetis roam around and inside the Foothill Caverns.

faq.q: What can be found inside the Foothill Caverns?
faq.answer: Feral yetis infest the Foothill Caverns, whose rocky walls hold veins of Alterac Granite prized by those who seek it.

faq.q: Why is this area considered so dangerous for travelers?
faq.answer: Fierce wildlife and yeti dens threaten travelers, and the open ground lies directly beside contested roadways. Alliance and Horde wanderers frequently ambush one another there.

angles.text: Darrow Hill's cave networks, especially the Foothill Caverns, hold rich veins of Alterac Granite and regional minerals. You must contend with the yetis nesting nearby.
You can hunt mountain lions and stags across the hills as they move between the Alterac tree line and the lower grasslands.
